observation_summary: The Cholesky decomposition failed to throw a NotPositiveDefiniteMatrixException for matrices that were not positive definite.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurred because the validation check for a positive definite matrix was performed prematurely in the Cholesky decomposition algorithm. The code attempted to verify the positivity of the diagonal element before the necessary calculations (specifically, the subtraction of squared off-diagonal elements) were completed for that row. By moving the check to occur after the intermediate calculations, the algorithm correctly identifies non-positive definite matrices that would have otherwise passed the check incorrectly.
